name: Houston Chronicle editorial board
lean_basis: AllSides rates the Houston Chronicle Center (independent review, low or initial confidence, as of Oct. 2026). No separate editorial-board rating was found.

name: League of Women Voters of Houston
lean_basis: League of Women Voters chapter; its president's stated priority is to preserve 'our nonpartisan mission' (https://www.lwvhouston.org/about). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Houston LGBTQ+ Political Caucus (The Caucus PAC)
lean_basis: LGBTQ+ political group that says it 'works with candidates and politicians to develop positive LGBTQ+ policies and legislation' (https://thecaucus.org/about/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Harris County Republican Party
lean_basis: Official county party organization. Publishes a roster of its Republican nominees and runs a joint campaign for Republican judicial candidates; no separate local endorsement slate found.

name: Texas Gulf Coast Area Labor Federation (AFL-CIO)
lean_basis: Regional AFL-CIO federation of about 95 unions; its site says 'Joining together in unions enables workers to negotiate for higher wages and benefits and improve conditions in the workplace' (https://www.gcaflcio.org/about). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.

name: Ground Game Texas
lean_basis: Self-described progressive group: 'Building a progressive Texas, from the ground up' (https://groundgametexas.org/). No outside rating found; lean reflects its stated mission.
